verdict.rationale: The DGX B300 documents a BMC with Redfish and IPMI management, which are standard programmatic interfaces for remote control of the system. CUDA guidance for Blackwell GPUs gives a documented programming interface to the hardware. However, the evidence only names these interfaces and provides no API reference, endpoint documentation or examples, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: a documented Redfish/management API reference specific to the B300, an OpenAPI or machine-readable spec, examples of programmatic or agent-driven control, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Use this guide when tuning CUDA kernels for Blackwell GPU architectures.
